description: This file implements RISC-V architecture-specific FPU (Floating Point Unit) management functions for Zephyr OS, including FPU save/restore, enable/disable, trap handling, and context switching.

methods.name: z_riscv_fpu_disable
methods.description: Disables FPU access by clearing the FS bits in mstatus and saving the FPU state if necessary.

methods.name: z_riscv_fpu_load
methods.description: Loads the FPU context for the current thread, setting ownership and restoring saved FP registers.

methods.name: arch_flush_local_fpu
methods.description: Flushes the local FPU context, saving if dirty, and clears ownership.

methods.name: z_riscv_fpu_enter_exc
methods.description: Disables FPU access upon entering an exception.

methods.name: z_riscv_fpu_trap
methods.description: Handles FPU trap, saving/restoring context as needed, and managing ownership during exceptions.

methods.name: fpu_access_allowed
methods.description: Determines if the current thread is allowed to access the FPU based on exception level and ownership.

methods.name: z_riscv_fpu_exit_exc
methods.description: Handles FPU state update upon exception exit, restoring FPU access bits.

methods.name: z_riscv_fpu_thread_context_switch
methods.description: Manages FPU access during thread context switches.

methods.name: arch_float_disable
methods.description: Disables FPU for a given thread, saving context if necessary.

methods.name: arch_float_enable
methods.description: Enables FPU for a thread (currently always returns 0).
